Hi Jamie -

Appreciate the clear list. Quick answers and next steps below.

SOC 2: Redwood is SOC 2 Type II compliant. Latest report: March 2027 (we can provide the report under NDA).

Ownership of SSQ: Marissa (cc'd) will own the questionnaire process and coordinate evidence. Expected turnaround: ~5 business days for the initial pass, depends on any deep-dive items.

Deployment options (high-level):
- Private VPC (recommended for Acme): customer-managed VPC peering or PrivateLink; single-tenant control plane option; default network isolation; supports KMS and audit logging.
- On-prem / air-gapped: available as an on-prem package for regulated workloads; requires an air-gapped installation window and local HSM/KMS integration.
- Hybrid: private control plane with on-prem inference nodes (for data locality).

I've attached a high-level deployment overview and a diagram stub - Monica will follow up with a more detailed topology.

Attachments: redwood-private-deployment-overview.pdf, acme-vpc-diagram.png (placeholder diagram we can adapt)

Next steps I propose:
1) Marissa will ingest the SSQ and send the initial answers (5 business day target).
2) Monica to schedule a tech runbook call to draw the exact VPC/subnet/security group layout (30-45m).
3) We'll provide SOC 2 report under NDA - please send your NDA or we can route via DocuSign.

If dates matter, we can prioritize the SSQ items you flagged as blockers.

Best,

Hi all -

Following up with the diagram and a few clarifications based on our call. Attached: acme-vpc-diagram.png (annotated) and a short PDF overview (redwood-private-deployment-overview.pdf).

Key notes for Acme private VPC:
- Network isolation: inference nodes run in customer subnets; control plane communicates over an authenticated management connection. No customer data is routed through Redwood's shared tenant network in private deployments.
- KMS: supports customer-managed KMS (Cloud KMS or HSM) - keys never leave your control unless you explicitly export them.
- Audit/logging: per-request audit logging available; logs can be forwarded to your SPLUNK/Cloud Logging or retained in S3/GCS buckets under your account.
- Air-gapped option: full on-prem installer available; requires a maintenance window and secure artifact transfer process.

Action items I can take this week:
- 45m topology call to finalize subnets/security groups (I have availability Thu 4/22 10:00-12:00 PT).
- Provide draft answers for network and encryption controls for the SSQ by Fri 4/23.

If that works, Marissa - once we have the SSQ we'll mark the technical items as 'owned by engineering' and provide artifact links.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
